title: Terrain
description: Every ground type the course is painted with, by tile id. From golf.exe's terrain table at 0x4c1a40 (0x30 bytes per row), which the game copies to 0x578350 whenever a course is set up. Money is in units of $100.

name.description: Name shown by the build tools and in golfers' thoughts.

cost.description: Price per tile painted, in $100 (the build menu's Cost).

hazard.description: How hard a shot from this ground is (0 to 8), used by the lie and the shot planner. Read only for now: shots have not been tested with other values.
